pages.name: Polish Opening: Tartakower Gambit
pages.notes: Overview called the b-pawn gambit a central-pawn sacrifice; plans targeted an f7-pawn that is on f6. Rewritten around Bc4 on the a2-g8 diagonal and f4-f5 (the Brinckmann line).

pages.name: Polish Opening: Wolferts Gambit
pages.notes: Overview called it a c-pawn sacrifice; the real point is that e5 falls to the b2-bishop after 3.bxc5 Bxc5 4.Bxe5. Plans rewritten; reviewer rejections (...Nf6 does not hit e5) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Polish: 1...d5 2.Bb2 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan had Black challenging the b2-bishop with ...Bf5 or a knight route d7-b6, and 0-0 notation. Rewritten around ...e6/...Bxb4 pressure, a3 or b5, c4 and ...c5.

pages.name: Polish: Schuehler Gambit
pages.notes: Plans had White using an open a-file (both a-pawns are on it) with Ra4-b4. Rewritten around 3...cxb5 4.e4 and Bxb5; Bxb5 added to skips (parser can't read the recapture after ...cxb5).

pages.name: Regan Variation
pages.notes: Plans had Qxd4 for White without the ...exd4 that allows it; overview's Scandinavian comparison dropped. Reviewer rejections (exd4 opening the g2-bishop's diagonal, ...Nf6 gaining time) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Sodium Attack: Chenoboskion Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 read the f4-square as a move and was generic. Rewritten around h4-h5 against g6 and ...d5 opening the c8-h3 diagonal against g4.

pages.name: Van Geet Opening: Dougherty Gambit
pages.notes: Plans needed ...exf3 before Nxf3 and used 0-0; overview now notes fxe4 regains the pawn if Black ignores 3.f3. Rewritten with the numbered line.

pages.name: Van Geet Opening: Kluever Gambit
pages.notes: Plans needed ...exd3 before Bxd3; overview's open e-file and long diagonal replaced with the b1-h7 diagonal and Qh5+ along e8-h5.

pages.name: Van Geet Opening: Napoleon Attack
pages.notes: Plans generic with 0-0 notation. Rewritten around the Scotch-like 3...exd4 4.Nxd4, ...Bb4 pinning the c3-knight, and 3...e4.

pages.name: Van Geet Opening: Novosibirsk Variation
pages.notes: Plan had Ng1-e2-f4 and Bc4 with the e2-pawn blocking both, and squares read as moves. Rewritten around Bg5, long castling and Black's development with gain of time.
